'''Mikhail Potapov''' ({{langx|ru|Михаи́л Миха́йлович Пота́пов}}) (born 1953) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr.Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[http://oc.cs.msu.su/people/prepods/362.html MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «Stable method for solving linear equations with noncompact operators and its applications to control and observation problems» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (2009).<ref>[http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/6135 Annals of the Moscow University]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

Author of 15 books and more than 50 scientific articles.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/michaelpotapov/ Scientific works of Mikhail Potapov]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=32462&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Mikhail Potapov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
